name: secret-shield
description: Set up SecretShield's local Chrome prompt guard and private composer for ChatGPT and Claude. Companion plugin; browser extension installation is required.

interface.longDescription: Install and evaluate the bundled SecretShield Chrome extension. Scan and mask common secrets locally before sharing text with ChatGPT or Claude. This companion does not itself intercept native chat messages; the Chrome extension provides browser input guards and a local composer. An engineering pilot, not universal DLP.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me set up SecretShield's local Chrome extension and verify its coverage with synthetic data.
